name: hf-model-filters
description: Browser extension adding extra filters to the Hugging Face models page

scripts.lint: npx --yes web-ext lint --ignore-files test package.json README.md amo-metadata.json
scripts.build: npx --yes web-ext build --overwrite-dest --ignore-files test package.json README.md amo-metadata.json
scripts.submit: npx --yes web-ext sign --channel listed --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json --ignore-files test package.json README.md amo-metadata.json
